(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define cf (color-frequency g))
             (define non-bg-colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c 0)) (grid-colors g)))
             (define rect-color
               (let loop
                    ((cs non-bg-colors) (best (first non-bg-colors)) (best-cnt 0))
                    (if (null? cs)
                        best
                        (let ((cnt (hash-ref cf (first cs))))
                          (if (> cnt best-cnt)
                              (loop (cdr cs) (first cs) cnt)
                              (loop (cdr cs) best best-cnt))))))
             (define rect-cells (find-color g rect-color))
             (define rs (map first rect-cells))
             (define cs (map second rect-cells))
             (define r1 (min-list rs))
             (define r2 (max-list rs))
             (define c1 (min-list cs))
             (define c2 (max-list cs))
             (define tl-in (list (+ r1 1) (+ c1 1)))
             (define tr-in (list (+ r1 1) (- c2 1)))
             (define bl-in (list (- r2 1) (+ c1 1)))
             (define br-in (list (- r2 1) (- c2 1)))
             (define tl-c (at g (first tl-in) (second tl-in)))
             (define tr-c (at g (first tr-in) (second tr-in)))
             (define bl-c (at g (first bl-in) (second bl-in)))
             (define br-c (at g (first br-in) (second br-in)))
             (define tl-out (list (- r1 1) (- c1 1)))
             (define tr-out (list (- r1 1) (+ c2 1)))
             (define bl-out (list (+ r2 1) (- c1 1)))
             (define br-out (list (+ r2 1) (+ c2 1)))
             (define g1 (set-cell g (first tl-in) (second tl-in) 0))
             (define g2 (set-cell g1 (first tr-in) (second tr-in) 0))
             (define g3 (set-cell g2 (first bl-in) (second bl-in) 0))
             (define g4 (set-cell g3 (first br-in) (second br-in) 0))
             (define g5 (set-cell g4 (first br-out) (second br-out) tl-c))
             (define g6 (set-cell g5 (first bl-out) (second bl-out) tr-c))
             (define g7 (set-cell g6 (first tr-out) (second tr-out) bl-c))
             (set-cell g7 (first tl-out) (second tl-out) br-c)))))
